title: Test Case Alpha — GEO Satellite Command Loss (Synthetic)
description: On 2009-08-12T14:30:00Z, a geostationary communications satellite became unresponsive to ground commands during a period of elevated solar energetic particle flux. This is a synthetic test case used to validate the multi-case pipeline architecture. All evidence values are representative of real GEO anomaly conditions but are not drawn from a specific historical event.
causal_attribution: Causal attribution is not established by the available evidence.

anchor_event.label: tca_command_loss
anchor_event.description: Last successful ground command contact lost. Satellite continued telemetry transmission. Command uplink unresponsive.

recovery_event.label: tca_recovery
recovery_event.description: Satellite autonomously resumed responding to ground commands after 3-day anomaly period.

data_sources.description: GOES-13 Energetic Particle Sensor — 5-minute averaged electron and proton flux
GOES-13 Magnetometer — 1-minute averaged magnetic field in GSM coordinates

scientific_limitations: GOES-13 measurements are a proxy; direct in-situ measurements at the target spacecraft are unavailable.
The 5-minute averaging of EP8 particle flux data smooths sub-minute impulsive flux increases.
Causation between the space weather environment and the command anomaly is not established.
Ground software and RF link conditions are not captured in this dataset.
